overview_description.description: Makkook.AI builds optimization-native Decision Intelligence Operating Systems for manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, and retail. Our multi-engine platform sits above existing enterprise systems to compute, execute, and monitor optimal operational decisions in real time. Using advanced optimization, Makkook reduces waste across materials, time, workforce, energy, and capacity while balancing competing business objectives simultaneously. The result is measurable, auditable, continuously improving decisions that turn complex operations into optimized, executable plans.
